headlines.title: Kraft Heinz (KHC) Enters Canada Ready To Eat Soup Market
headlines.summary: Kraft Heinz (NYSE:KHC) is launching the HEINZ Soup Collection in Canada, its first ready to eat soup line in the country. The range uses bag packaging instead of cans, targeting consumers looking for quicker meal solutions and easier storage. The move extends Kraft Heinz beyond traditional canned products into a new packaged meal category within the Canadian market.

headlines.title: Kraft Heinz faces worsening US sales as $700 million turnaround spending ramps up
headlines.summary: Kraft Heinz Co (NASDAQ:KHC, XETRA:KHNZ) faces worsening US retail demand as it ramps up a $700 million investment programme, with Jefferies retaining a 'hold' rating and cutting its price target to $21.

headlines.title: Why McCormick Stock Stands Out As Investors Seek Defensive Dividend Shares
headlines.summary: Inflation just surprised to the upside again, Fed rate-hike odds jumped, and bond yields are pressing multi decade highs, which suddenly makes cash and Treasuries feel comfortable. That shift pulls attention away from equities and toward companies that pay investors to wait. In this article, you will see three large cap, high dividend stocks from our U.S. screener that are directly exposed to this new rate and inflation story.

headlines.title: GIS Stock Is Down 13% in the Past Month: Is the Sell-Off a Chance?
headlines.summary: General Mills shares have fallen 13% in a month, leaving the stock at a valuation discount. Can retail gains and cost savings offset weak demand and earnings pressure?

description: The Kraft Heinz Company, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and markets food and beverage products in North America and internationally. Its products include condiments, sauces, dressings, and spreads; cheese, frozen potato products, and other frozen meals; meal kits, frozen snacks, and pickles; dry packaged desserts, refrigerated ready to eat desserts, and other dessert toppings; ready to drink and powdered beverages, and liquid concentrates; American sliced and recipe cheeses; mainstream coffee, coffee pods, and premium coffee; and cold cuts, bacon, and hot dogs. It offers its products under the Kraft, Oscar Mayer, Heinz, Philadelphia, Lunchables, Velveeta, Ore-Ida, Capri Sun, Maxwell House, Kool-Aid, Jell-O, ABC, Master, Quero, Golden Circle, Wattie's, Pudliszki, and Plasmon brands, as well as Bagel Bites, Claussen, A1, and Cool Whip. It sells its products through its own sales organizations, as well as through independent brokers, agents, and distributors to chain, wholesale, cooperative, and independent grocery accounts; convenience, value, and club stores; pharmacies and drug stores; mass merchants; foodservice distributors; institutions, including hotels, restaurants, bakeries, hospitals, health care facilities, and government agencies; and various e-commerce platforms and retailers. The company has a strategic partnership with the National Football League. The company was formerly known as H.J. Heinz Holding Corporation and changed its name to The Kraft Heinz Company in July 2015. The company was founded in 1869 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
